result.summary: The page is generally visually sound. Found one minor styling inconsistency regarding a missing icon background.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' promotional image is missing the dark circular background present on the identical icon in the pizza card below it.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-transparent dark circular background behind the heart icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image to match the styling of the other card and ensure the icon is clearly visible against all image backgrounds.
